svg.aria-label: From a book request to a file in the ingest folder: 1. Search: Shelfmark queries Prowlarr for Usenet releases and the Hardcover, Google Books and Moly metadata providers for the title. 2. Usenet: A Usenet pick goes to SABnzbd in the books category. The file is saved on shared-downloads at the path SABnzbd reports. 3. Direct: Direct downloads come from Anna's Archive mirrors and LibGen search. Cloudflare-fronted pages go through FlareSolverr. 4. Rename: Files are renamed to Author - Title (Year) and written to /cwa-book-ingest, the NFS ingest folder that Calibre-Web Automated reads. 5. Check: A read-only mount of the CWA library lets Shelfmark see which books are already held.
